# nginxproxymanager_user_password

Resource behaviour:
- During an `apply`, the password for the user is set.
- During a `delete`, nothing happens. This is because the password cannot be removed or reset via the API.

**This resource does not support importing.**

## Example Usage 

```terraform
resource "nginxproxymanager_user" "user" {
  name     = "My User"
  nickname = "Cool Nickname"
  email    = "user@domain.com"
  roles    = ["admin"]
}

resource "nginxproxymanager_user_password" "user" {
  user_id  = nginxproxymanager_user.user.id
  password = "SuperS3cr3tP4ssw0rd!"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password to set for the user.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user (required).
